text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus was injured, so we headed to 
the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're exaggerating, Trainer. 
Something like this is nothing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
See, just like this! A hero doesn't get 
discouraged by a little setback!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna keep training! I'm gonna get 
stronger and stronger!
choice_data_list:
No, you should rest and take it easy for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! I'm really totally fine though...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I understand. If you say so, 
Trainer, I'll take it easy and rest!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"You understand me better than anyone 
else, Trainer! My captain's orders are 
never wrong!"
choice_data_list:
Yeah, please carry out the mission of 
resting!
Yeah, carry out your mission to rest!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Aye-aye, Captain! I'll heal this injury in 
no time with pure guts!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer! All right, let's get 
right back to the track!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ow ow... Dammit... My heart wants to run 
so badly, and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...I understand... I'm sorry for pushing 
myself. I'll do my best to get this injury 
healed...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside the dejected Biko Pegasus, I 
headed back to the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Were you watching, Trainer?! Seems 
like I can manage running this much!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for believing in me! Now we can 
get back to our special training!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Toryaaaaah! I'm gonna become a cool 
hero--!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While keeping an eye on her injury, Biko 
Pegasus continued to do her best within 
her limits.
